failures.text: How does an idea get from a draft all the way to paper trading with real allocated capital?
failures.answer: Sir, an idea climbs a fixed staircase. A draft waits for your yes, then it is registered, meaning the test is written down before it runs. It is then tested on 2000-2023 data against the strict pass mark, and a survivor runs as a paper shadow book for 20 live sessions. It is admitted only if it beats random picks and the average stock on 10 separate sessions after costs, passes a check that no future data leaked in, and you say yes; only then may the allocated paper capital use it, and real money needs the final gate and your yes as well. Nothing has been admitted yet: the stock rules are at 16 of 20 practice sessions of the 20 needed and the options line at 12 of 20.

problems.why: It opens with "fixed staircase" and uses unexplained terms like "paper shadow book", "survivor" and "final gate", which a beginner would not follow; the 20-session and 10-session figures are also muddled.

problems.why: Madhav is the one speaking (his sign-in and voice context), yet Ananta greets him as 'grader' and treats him as a stranger, with no 'sir'.
He asked whether Ananta can remember his voice and say who it is talking to, and explained why he asked; the answer addresses neither the voice-recognition question nor his 'open it' request.
He was making a point about voice recognition and earlier identity questions, but the answer gives a generic stranger introduction as if he were a new guest.

results.text: Ananta, what big events are coming up that could move the market?
results.answer: Sir, the nearest one is India's October inflation (CPI) today, Thursday 12 Nov at 16:00 IST, after the close, so the first session that can trade it is Friday 13 Nov. Next come the GDP release for July-September on Monday 30 Nov (16:00 IST, first tradable on Tuesday 1 Dec) and the RBI rate decision on Friday 4 Dec at about 10:00 IST, during the session. The US jobs report follows on 4 Dec (19:00 IST, first tradable on Monday 7 Dec), and the US Fed decision comes at 00:30 IST on Thursday 10 Dec. Nifty options also expire on Tuesday 17 Nov, which can make that day choppier.

results.text: Ananta, how is the book doing?
results.answer: Which book do you mean, sir? 1. the practice book (the research trades). 2. my account on paper (the managed book). 3. the index options line.

results.text: Ananta, when do you ask me which one I mean?
results.answer: Sir, I ask only when a wrong guess would cost something: which draft to approve or skip, which book you mean (stocks, options or the managed book), or what to flag when nothing came before it. I never ask for a plain fact question. I ask once with 2-4 choices, and after that your pick is the answer. In the last 7 days I asked twice, both about which book you meant, and you picked a choice both times.
